label: Говоря
description: A 10-sentence card for говоря, the imperfective gerund of говорить.

missions.phrase: Говоря по телефону, она ходила по комнате.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Front position. Говоря is formed from the present stem of говорить (говор-ят) plus -я. The fronted gerund names the action concurrent with the main verb ходила — she paced while talking.
Strategic focus: End position. Here говоря closes the sentence and runs parallel to улыбался. Both actions belong to the subject он and happen at the same moment.
Strategic focus: Present tense. The main verb звучишь is present, and говоря marks the simultaneous manner: speaking slowly, you sound calmer. The gerund carries no tense of its own.
Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The one who speaks in говоря must be the one who loses trust in the main clause — a single subject человек. The gerund cannot have a separate doer of its own.

missions.phrase: Говоря тихо, дети не разбудят отца.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause is future (не разбудят), but говоря stays unchanged — gerunds have no future form. Speaking quietly, they will avoid waking him.

missions.phrase: Депутаты спорили, говоря о новом законе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural subject. Even with the plural subject депутаты, the form stays говоря — gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending, unlike the participle говорящие.

missions.phrase: Говоря это, она смотрела в окно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb смотрела is past, yet говоря marks concurrency: while saying this, she looked out the window. The imperfective gerund signals overlap, not sequence.

missions.phrase: Говоря честно, я очень устал сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Fixed idiomatic form. Говоря честно works as a set phrase meaning frankly speaking, and the gerund stays unchanged whatever the subject. Its indeclinability is what lets it serve as such a frozen connector.

missions.phrase: Говоря с акцентом, он всё же понятен.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. With the masculine subject он the gerund stays говоря, taking no gender or case ending. A participle would inflect; the gerund holds one fixed shape always.

missions.phrase: Учитель ходил, говоря об истории России.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Учитель is the shared subject of both ходил and говоря, the actions overlapping in time. The gerund compresses while he spoke into one indeclinable word.
